part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `ResultRow.populateFromCache` (processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/groupby/ResultRow.java:178): when restoring result-level-cache rows, the loop consumed every cached post-aggregator value but never incremented `postPos`, so all values were written into the first post-agg slot (last one wins) and the remaining slots stayed null. With 0 or 1 post-aggregator the bug was invisible, but with 2+ it corrupted the output — matching the reported behavior.

The fix is a one-line change adding `postPos++` to the loop. Verification: `GroupByQueryQueryToolChestTest` (which round-trips a row with two post-aggregators through `prepareForCache(true)`/`pullFromCache(true)`) and the full `GroupBy*Test` suite (8105 tests) all pass.
